title: Personal Knowledge & PKM Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Obsidian graph stats (`obsidian:stats`), Roam daily notes (`roam:daily`), Logseq tasks (`logseq:task`), Zettelkasten notes (`zettel:note`), PKM review summaries (`pkm:review`).
app: Obsidian graph stats, Roam daily notes, Logseq task exports, and Zettelkasten counts streamed to Splunk HEC via plugins, CSV exports, and scripted vault scans.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=obsidian:stats) OR (index=personal sourcetype=roam:daily)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="obsidian:stats","primary",sourcetype="roam:daily","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from obsidian:stats and roam:daily to see whether two personal knowledge feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `obsidian:stats` and `roam:daily` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main personal knowledge data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
